description: This source file defines the EventHubQueueCache class, which manages caching of EventHub data within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes cache management, pressure monitoring, and purging logic, facilitating efficient event stream processing.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of EventHub messages for a specific partition, including cache pressure management, purging, and cursor-based reading.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Triggers a cache purge based on eviction strategy.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a cache pressure monitor to influence cache management decisions.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources and resets eviction strategy callbacks.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the cache, considering current pressure.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache, returning their stream positions.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor object for reading from the cache at a specific stream position.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message from the cache using the provided cursor.
